apps.name: Glow for Facebook
apps.subtitle: Cleaner. Smarter. Yours.
apps.localizedDescription:
Features:
- Download whatever you like — videos, images, Reels, and even stories
- Stay unseen. View stories and mark them as seen only when you want to
- Worried about accidental likes? Now you can relax
- Flexible, intuitive settings — all tailored to you

Glow settings are available via long press on any tab

apps.name: RyukGram
apps.subtitle: Instagram, supercharged with RyukGram · by @axryuk · RyukGram v1.4.0
apps.localizedDescription: RyukGram is an enhanced Instagram client for iOS — the full Instagram app with a built-in suite of privacy, logging and customization tweaks. Highlights: follow-request tracking, read receipts, story-viewer insights, deleted-message logs, device-ID masking, media downloading, custom chat themes and a configurable tab bar. Everything runs on-device.
